'''Skulker''' is the name of the horse owned by [[Juilin Sandar]].

==Appearance==
Skulker is a lanky brown gelding.

==Activities==
Skulker carries Juilin from [[Tanchico]], through [[Tarabon]] and into [[Amadicia]]{{ref/book|5|8}} and then into the village of [[Mardecin]].{{ref/book|5|9}} Later, he and Juilin go from [[Sienda]] to [[Valan Luca]] [[Valan Luca's Traveling Show|traveling show]],{{ref/book|5|17}} and then with the show into [[Samara]].{{ref/book|5|36}}
